newsitem.title: UK: Higher prices drive buyers out of UK meals market.
newsitem.headline: Higher prices drive buyers out of UK meals market.

text.p: Soaring high protein soymeal prices kept most buyers out of the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday.
High pro prices jumped up as much a five stg a tonne following the firm close in Chicago.
"You could not see buyers for dust this morning once they saw the prices," said one broker.
Other said there had been a lot talking in the market but very little had resulted in business.
"There have been a few oddball trades into the country but nothing that would mean anything to the main market," said another broker.
